requirements.value: Must have been issued a certificate or license to practice optometry by a state with standards at least equal to Arkansas; engaged in lawful practice for 3 of past 4 years; passed Arkansas jurisprudence examination; provided proof of completion of all parts of NBEO examination; provided therapeutic license and CPR certification; provided transcripts; provided good standing certificate; provided information on malpractice claims and disciplinary actions; submitted to criminal background check
requirements.quote: Has been issued a certificate or license to practice optometry by a state, territory, the District of Columbia, or Canada having standards of proficiency at least equal to the standards of Arkansas; Has engaged in the lawful practice of optometry for a period of three (3) years of the past four (4) years in the other state, territory, the District of Columbia, or Canada and has complied with all the requirements of the Arkansas licensure law at the time of application; and Has passed an Arkansas jurisprudence examination

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry means the examination, diagnosis, treatment, and management of conditions of the human eye, lid, adnexa, and visual system, including the removal of foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva, lid, or adnexa but shall exclude other surgery of the lid, adnexa, or visual system which requires anything other than a topical anesthetic.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry means the examination, diagnosis, treatment, and management of conditions of the human eye, lid, adnexa, and visual system, including the removal of foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva, lid, or adnexa but shall exclude other surgery of the lid, adnexa, or visual system which requires anything other than a topical anesthetic

value: prescribing and sale of eyeglasses and contact lenses
prescribing and administering oral and topical drugs
prescribing and administering epinephrine and comparable medication for anaphylaxis
removal and biopsy of skin lesions with low risk of malignancy
methods_authorized.quote: the prescribing and sale of eyeglasses and contact lenses, the prescribing and administering of all oral and topical drugs for the diagnosis or treatment only of conditions of the eye, lids, and adnexa, and the prescribing and administering of epinephrine, benadryl, or other comparable medication for the emergency treatment of anaphylaxis or anaphylactic reactions

drug_authority.value: Optometrists may prescribe and administer all oral and topical drugs for diagnosis or treatment of conditions of the eye, lids, and adnexa; may prescribe epinephrine and comparable medication for anaphylaxis; prohibited from Schedules I and II except hydrocodone combination drugs in combination with oral analgesic drugs (limited to 72 hours, no refills)
drug_authority.quote: the prescribing and administering of all oral and topical drugs for the diagnosis or treatment only of conditions of the eye, lids, and adnexa, and the prescribing and administering of epinephrine, benadryl, or other comparable medication for the emergency treatment of anaphylaxis or anaphylactic reactions

surgery_prohibited.quote: All licensed optometrists are prohibited from using ophthalmic lasers for surgical procedures except as permitted in subdivision (a)(3)(D) of this section, performing cataract surgery, performing radial keratotomy surgery

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: including the removal of foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva, lid, or adnexa

value: removal and biopsy of skin lesions with low risk of malignancy (excluding lesions involving lid margin or nasal to puncta)
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Injections, excluding intravenous or intraocular injections; Incision and curettage of a chalazion; Removal and biopsy of skin lesions with low risk of malignancy, excluding lesions involving the lid margin or nasal to the puncta

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: the prescribing and administering of epinephrine, benadryl, or other comparable medication for the emergency treatment of anaphylaxis or anaphylactic reactions

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: who prescribes, tints, coats, dispenses, adapts, or duplicates lenses, prisms, ocular exercises, visual therapy, or orthoptics for the correction, relief, or aid of the visual functions

value: Schedule II (except hydrocodone combination drugs in combination with oral analgesic drugs)
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: Optometrists are excluded from possessing, administering, or prescribing those pharmaceutical agents listed in Schedules I and II of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act, § 5-64-101 et seq., except hydrocodone combination drugs, regardless of their schedule, in combination with oral analgesic drugs.

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: A prescription written by an optometrist for hydrocodone combination drugs, regardless of their schedule, in combination with oral analgesic drugs, shall not exceed seventy-two (72) hours and shall not authorize refills

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: the prescribing and administering of all oral and topical drugs for the diagnosis or treatment only of conditions of the eye, lids, and adnexa

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: No optometrist shall be so approved until he or she has: Exhibited his or her qualifications by passing an examination prepared or approved by the board; and Served an internship program established by the board, supervised and certified by a board-certified ophthalmologist, which internship includes at least one hundred (100) hours of supervised clinical training

tiered_license_types.quote: Those licensed optometrists who meet the qualifications and standards established by the board shall be designated optometric physicians

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: internship includes at least one hundred (100) hours of supervised clinical training in the examination, diagnosis, and treatment of conditions of the human eye and adnexa

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: Served an internship program established by the board, supervised and certified by a board-certified ophthalmologist, which internship includes at least one hundred (100) hours of supervised clinical training

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: A written contact lens prescription shall expire one (1) year after the date of the completion of the contact lens fitting unless there is a medical reason that warrants a prescription for less than one (1) year

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: the optometrist or physician practicing as an ophthalmologist shall upon request of the patient provide to the patient a complete and accurate written prescription at no additional charge

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: Impaired Optometrist Treatment program means the State Board of Optometry-approved or sponsored program for the detection, intervention, and monitoring of impaired providers

jurisprudence_exam_required.quote: Has passed an Arkansas jurisprudence examination

criminal_background_check_required.quote: Application to the Identification Bureau of the Division of Arkansas State Police for a state and national criminal background check, to be conducted by the Federal Bureau of Investigation, which shall include the taking of fingerprints
